jobs.description:
Welcome to Traxial: Where big ideas start small (but mighty)
 

Join Traxial as a Mechanical Design Engineer and take ownership for Precision Gearboxes . You'll work from concept to prototype and production, combining detailed mechanical design with hands-on validation.
 

This is what you'll do:
 
 

•  

Design and develop precision gearboxes for new product applications, from concept through prototype and production.
   
 

•  

Design mechanical components such as gears, shafts, bearings, housings, seals, and other transmission elements.
   
 

•  

Create detailed 3D CAD models and 2D manufacturing drawings, applying relevant industry standards and GD&T.
   
 

•  

Perform and support mechanical calculations and design verification.
   
 

•  

Work closely with suppliers and subcontractors on gearbox components, manufacturing processes, tolerances, materials, and specifications.
  

•  

Support prototype builds, testing, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement of gearbox and actuator designs.
  

Who are we looking for?
 
 

•  

Master's degree in Mechanical or Electro-Mechanical Engineering, or equivalent experience.
   
 

•  

At least 3 years of professional experience in gearbox, drivetrain or precision mechanical component design.
   
 

•  

Proficient in Siemens NX, Teamcenter PDM, or similar CAD/PDM tools.
   
 

•  

Good knowledge of materials and manufacturing processes for gearbox components, including gear machining, heat treatment, tolerancing, and design-for-manufacturing principles.
   
 

•  

Strong analytical skills and experience performing mechanical calculations, such as gear sizing, shaft strength and bearing selection.
   
 

•  

Experience in Romax, KISSsoft or similar packages for gear calculation is a plus.
   
 

•  

This position requires existing work authorization in Belgium.
   
 

•  

A team player with a can-do mentality, creative mindset, and fluent English.

Do you dream of a job with no routine work, where you build a unique finished product from A to Z? For a stable and valued family-owned company in the region, we are looking for a mature Structural Metal Worker / Fitter.

 

As a Structural Metal Worker, you are responsible for the full assembly and custom fitting directly onto the truck chassis:

• Reading Blueprint Plans & Preparation: You read complex technical drawings and bending diagrams like second nature. You saw, drill, cut, and work with lasers based on these plans.
• Assembly & Fitting: You assemble parts with precision down to the millimeter. Think of constructing stairs, doors, frames, and specific structures.
• Metalworking & Bending: You perform the necessary bending and drilling work. Logical reasoning is essential here: when a drawing is challenging, you know exactly how to make the parts fit together seamlessly.
• Light Welding: A small part of your duties includes MIG/MAG welding (assembling/tack welding). However, the main focus is on total assembly.

 Jouw profiel als Constructiemedewerker / Samensteller.

• Experience & Maturity: You have already gained solid and relevant experience in metal construction, assembly, or fitting (e.g., custom doors, stairs, or structures). Due to the complexity of the work, we are looking for a mature candidate who can work independently.
• Technical Insight: You excel at reading blueprint drawings, have excellent spatial awareness, and can reason logically.
• Metalworking Skills: You have experience with various metalworking techniques (drilling, bending, cutting). Experience with or training in MIG/MAG welding is a nice plus, but not a requirement!
• Language Skills: You communicate fluently in English.

jobs.occupation: Pilot Line Process Engineer – Atomic Layer Deposition
jobs.description:
What you will do
 

The Pilot Line Engineer is responsible for: 
 
 

• Daily follow-up of process & tool qualification, stability, improvements and problem prevention.  

• Troubleshoots issues related to the processing and enables first and second line trouble shooters to step up.  

• Investigates recurring issues, focusing on root cause analysis and structural solutions.  

• Keeps focus on quality and reproducibility, monitoring stability and taking actions in case of process fluctuations.  

• Designs experimental plans and executes them in the cleanroom, performing data analysis and taking care of reporting and documentation.  

• Works in a dynamic multidisciplinary and multicultural environment in close cooperation with researchers, hardware engineers, operations, industry assignees, device and process experts.  

• Works in a two-shifts system (Early/Late) including 1weekend (Sa/Su) out of 4.  

Who you are
 
 

• You obtained a Master in Science or in Engineering or equal to this by experience, and you display strong engineering skills and mindset.  

• You are able to rapidly adapt to changes in circumstances by being able to change priorities at very short notice.  

• A process & quality driven problem solver: you manage multiple priorities in a flexible manner in a continuously changing environment with a proactive “can do” attitude.  

• You take ownership and you enjoy completing your tasks autonomously.  

• As you will work in cross functional teams, strong communication and reporting skills are required.  

• You are a flexible team player, and you enjoy working in environments where experiences and knowledge are shared with colleagues.  

• Given the international character of imec, fluency in English is a must.

Comecer is expanding its international Service Team! To strengthen our team in Belgium, we are looking for 
Field Service Engineers, preferably based in the 
Brussels–Leuven region. You will be employed by Orise NV 
(former Process Automation Solutions), based in Belgium, and part of ATS Corporation, while working closely with Comecer Netherlands BV and the wider Comecer team.
 

In this role, you will help install, maintain and support high-tech systems that play a critical role in the (radio)pharmaceutical and nuclear medicine sectors.
 

Comecer’s solutions are developed and manufactured in Joure (The Netherlands) and are used in complex laboratory environments worldwide.
 

 
 

What you will do
 

In this role, you will be 
responsible for installing, servicing, and maintaining Comecer equipment at customer sites throughout Belgium. You will carry out both preventive and corrective maintenance, ensuring that each system performs optimally and meets all operational requirements. In addition, you will provide 
training and technical support to end users, helping them understand and operate the equipment effectively. Throughout every assignment, you will communicate clearly and professionally with customers and internal teams, representing Comecer as a trusted, solution-oriented technical expert.

What you bring
 

You bring hands‑on experience in repairing technical equipment and troubleshooting both mechanical and electrical issues. You are able to read and interpret electrical, pneumatic and mechanical drawings, and you have a background in electronics, electromechanics or mechanical engineering. In this role, strong communication skills and a customer‑focused attitude are essential, along with a willingness to travel within Belgium and occasionally abroad. You have an energetic, proactive and solution‑driven mindset.
 

Requirements:
 
 

• Technical degree at secondary or bachelor level (electromechanics, electronics or mechatronics). 

• Strong English and French skills; Dutch is an advantage. 

• Experience with PLC-controlled systems is considered as a plus. 

• Valid category B driving licence.

Welcome to Traxial: Where big ideas start small (but mighty)
 

At Traxial, we don't just design solutions—we engineer the future with bold ideas and a hands-on approach. Our mission is to rethink what's possible in engineering and R&D. Though our team is small, our ambitions are anything but. We move fast, think big, and are driven by curiosity and a shared passion for innovation.
 

About the role
 

Join our R&D team as a Mechanical Design Engineer , where you'll contribute to the development of cutting-edge axial flux motors. 
 

This is what you'll do: 
 
 

•  

Design innovative solutions for new product challenges. 
   
 

•  

Create detailed 3D CAD models and 2D drawings following industry standards. 
   
 

•  

Coordinate with suppliers and subcontractors on design and specifications. 
  

Who are we looking for? 
 
 

•  

Master's degree in Mechanical or Electro-Mechanical Engineering, or equivalent experience. 
   
 

•  

At least 3 years of professional experience in mechanical design and development. 
   
 

•  

Proficient in Siemens NX, Teamcenter PDM or similar CAD/PDM tools. 
   
 

•  

Skilled in DFMEA, DFM, DFA, and geometric dimensioning and tolerancing. 
   
 

•  

Knowledgeable about material properties (metals and plastics), production techniques, and problem-solving methodologies. 
   
 

•  

Strong analytical skills to perform mechanical calculation (eg: reaction forces, bolt sizing, bearing selection).
   
 

•  

This position requires existing work authorization in Belgium.
   
 

•  

A team player with a can-do mentality, creative mindset, and fluent in English.

Traxx is looking for a Mechanical and Thermal Simulations Engineer to join our rapidly growing team. You will be responsible for the structural and mechanical simulation of our axial flux motors and their components, while supporting the development and validation of thermal models for our motors and inverters. 
 

This is what you'll do:
 
 

•  

Strengthen the Simulation Team by improving our structural and mechanical simulation capabilities. 
   
 

•  

Perform structural FEA simulations to evaluate strength, stiffness, fatigue, vibration, and thermal-mechanical behavior of motor components.
   
 

•  

Support the development and validation of thermal simulation models for axial flux motors and power electronics.
   
 

•  

Develop analytical models to complement simulation results and support design decisions.
   
 

•  

Design tests and prototypes required to validate analyses, and correlate simulation results with experimental data.
   
 

•  

Perform root cause analyzes of product and process issues and provide simulation driven recommendations for design improvements.
  

Who are we looking for?
 
 

•  

Master's degree in Electrical or Electronic Engineering, or equivalent experience.
   
 

•  

Deep understanding of electromagnetism and at least 2 years of hands-on experience with electromagnetic simulations.
   
 

•  

Basic understanding of different engineering domains: mechanics, NVH, thermodynamics, ...
   
 

•  

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
   
 

•  

Proficiency in Ansys Maxwell, Jmag, Altair or similar as well as Python
  

•  

Strong English communication skills (both written and verbal), good collaboration skills, and the ability to work effectively across teams within the organizations.

As a Team Leader – Production, you play a key role in our manufacturing operations. You are responsible for coordinating the daily production activities while leading and supporting your team. By combining a people-oriented leadership style with a focus on quality, safety, and continuous improvement, you help achieve production targets and maintain the highest quality standards.

Your Responsibilities:

Are You the Team Leader We're Looking For?

As a Van Driver & Logistics Operator, you are the link between our workshop and our customers. You will be responsible for carrying out daily logistics operations across Brussels and throughout Belgium, ensuring that every customer receives a scooter that meets our quality standards.

You will be one of the faces of MUTE on the road and will play a key role in delivering an exceptional customer experience.

Your Responsibilities

Deliveries & Collections

• Deliver electric scooters to customers.
• Collect scooters requiring maintenance or repairs.
• Carry out vehicle swaps when needed.
• Load and unload scooters safely and efficiently.
Logistics Operations

• Optimize routes to maximize operational efficiency.
• Keep the company van clean, organized and in good condition.
• Report any damage or operational issues concerning transported vehicles.
Customer Service

• Represent MUTE professionally during every customer interaction.
• Introduce customers to the basic operation of their scooter upon delivery.
• Answer basic customer questions.
• Ensure every delivery reflects the high service standards of MUTE.
Operational Support

When deliveries are completed, you will support the workshop and logistics team by:

• Moving scooters within the warehouse.
• Preparing vehicles for delivery.
• Cleaning and inspecting scooters.
• Charging and handling batteries safely.
• Assisting the operations team based on daily priorities. 
We are looking for someone who is reliable, proactive and enjoys working independently.

Requirements

• Valid Category B driving licence (mandatory).
• Comfortable driving a delivery van in urban environments.
• Reliable, punctual and well organized.
• Careful with equipment and company vehicles.
• Able to work independently while maintaining high quality standards.
• Physically fit, as the role involves loading and unloading electric scooters.
Preferred Qualifications

• Previous experience in logistics, deliveries or transportation.
• Interest in electric vehicles or sustainable mobility.
• Experience in the mobility, automotive or technical sector is a plus.
• Good knowledge of Brussels and surrounding areas.
Languages

• Good command of English and French.

• 6-month full-time contract (38 hours per week), with the possibility of a permanent contract (CDI) based on performance and business needs.
• A dynamic and fast-growing company.

jobs.occupation: warehouse worker / forklift operator - night shift
jobs.description:
Looking for a permanent job on the fixed night shift within an international logistics environment? Then this job might be just the thing for you.

Your responsibilities:

• Loading and unloading containers and trucks with the forklift according to applicable safety procedures.
• Operating the forklift and electric pallet trucks for the efficient internal transport of goods.
• Managing and accurately moving goods within the cold warehouse.
• As a warehouse worker and forklift driver, you work closely with colleagues to ensure the logistics process runs smoothly at night.
You work in a fixed night shift. Start time can be at 16:00 or at 18:30. You choose one of the two for your entire employment.

VG 458/BUOSAP

You hold a forklift certificate, or are willing to take a practical driving test.

You are fluent in Dutch or English (both spoken and written).

You are a great team player.

You prioritize working safely and accurately.

You ensure an optimal flow of goods throughout the entire night shift.

The garage not only sells and rents high-quality German vehicles, but also carries out maintenance and repairs to the highest standards.

As a diagnosic technician in the Veurne region, your responsibilities include:

  • Performing vehicle diagnostics;
  • Establishing diagnoses and setting up diagnostic equipment;
  • Carrying out repairs and replacing parts;
  • Working on passenger cars, vans and trucks (depending on experience and skills);
  • Performing maintenance work;
  • Resolving mechanical and electronic issues.
As a diagnosic Technician in the Veurne region, you recognize yourself in the following:

  • You already have a basic knowledge of automotive technology;
  • You are a motivated technician with a passion for technology;
  • You speak Dutch or English.

Are you an experienced pipe fitter who has previously worked in a pharmaceutical environment?

We are looking for an experienced pipe fitter for an ongoing project in Geel.

As a company, we are a European player specialising in complex construction projects such as data centres.

Together with your team, you will be responsible for preparing, installing and aligning stainless steel pipes used for sterile/clean processes.

In practical terms, this involves the following tasks:

• Interpreting (3D) plans and diagrams (process flows, pipes, valves, instruments, etc.)

• Installing (hygienic) stainless steel and carbon steel pipes

• Aligning pipes in preparation for the welders

• Fitting brackets, pipe racks, etc.

• Quality checks

• An eye for cleanliness and safety

Naturally, you will always adhere to the applicable procedures regarding working methods and safety.

The working language is English, so you must be proficient in this.

You must already hold a valid VCA certificate and technical competence.

In addition, you have over 5 years’ relevant experience.

Overtime occurs on a weekly basis and is generously paid at 150%.

In addition to an attractive salary in accordance with PC124, you will receive meal vouchers worth €2.59 per day worked.
